# Horizon Ventures

> A one-person software company registered in Peru (Horizon Ventures E.I.R.L., RUC 20612763888)
> that builds narrow apps for Atlassian Confluence Cloud. The apps run entirely on Atlassian
> infrastructure under the Runs on Atlassian programme: no vendor servers, and no customer
> data leaves the customer's own Confluence site. Support is answered by the developer who
> wrote the code. Free for teams up to 10 people.

## Apps

- [Clickable SVG](https://horizonventures.app/clickable-svg.html): Confluence renders SVG diagrams as flat pictures and kills the links inside them. This app restores them, so clicking a shape opens the Confluence page behind it. Links are bound to the page rather than its URL, so renaming or moving a page does not break the diagram. Reads SVG, draw.io, Mermaid and PlantUML. $2 per user per month, free up to 10 users.
- [Smart Search](https://horizonventures.app/smart-search.html): builds live lists of Confluence pages from plain conditions such as a space, labels, or "not updated for 180 days" — no query language required. The list updates itself as pages change. CQL is available in manual mode. $1 per user per month, free up to 10 users. Available now on the Atlassian Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/1801528247/smart-search-live-page-lists-without-queries

- [Table Export](https://horizonventures.app/table-export.html): exports Confluence tables to CSV or Excel. One table, a whole page, or every table in a space collected into a single workbook. Merged cells are expanded so columns stay aligned in the file. $1.50 per user per month, free up to 10 users.
- [Word Import](https://horizonventures.app/word-import.html): imports Word documents into Confluence and builds a page tree from them, keeping headings, tables and images. Files are read inside your browser, so nothing is uploaded to a third party. $2 per user per month, free up to 10 users.

## Availability

Smart Search is published and can be installed today from the Atlassian Marketplace. Clickable SVG, Table Export and Word Import have been submitted and are awaiting Atlassian's review; they cannot be installed yet.

## Documentation

- [Clickable SVG documentation](https://horizonventures.app/docs/): getting started, supported diagram formats, linking shapes to pages, search inside a diagram, safety model, known limits.
- [Smart Search documentation](https://horizonventures.app/docs/smart-search/): building a list, conditions, live behaviour, manual CQL mode.
- [Table Export documentation](https://horizonventures.app/docs/table-export/): exporting one table, a page or a whole space, and how merged cells are handled.
- [Word Import documentation](https://horizonventures.app/docs/word-import/): importing .docx files, what is preserved, and how the page tree is built.

## Replacing abandoned Confluence apps

- [SVG out alternative](https://horizonventures.app/docs/svg-out-alternative.html): what happens when SVG out disappears and how to move diagrams over.
- [Mermaid app alternative](https://horizonventures.app/docs/mermaid-confluence-alternative.html): what to do when a Mermaid renderer stops being maintained, including the free options.
- [PlantUML app alternative](https://horizonventures.app/docs/plantuml-confluence-alternative.html): the same question for PlantUML diagrams.
- [Connect end of life](https://horizonventures.app/docs/connect-end-of-life.html): what a Confluence admin has to do about apps built on the Connect platform, and how to audit their own site.

- [Importing Word documents into Confluence](https://horizonventures.app/docs/import-word-into-confluence.html): the built-in .docx import step by step, what survives, what breaks, and when an archive needs a dedicated tool.

- [Getting a Confluence table into Excel](https://horizonventures.app/docs/export-confluence-table-to-excel.html): no native export exists; the free routes, the merged-cell trap, and when a tool is justified.

- [What to check before installing a Confluence app](https://horizonventures.app/docs/what-to-check-before-installing-app.html): Where your data goes, what the Marketplace badges really mean, how to spot an abandoned app, and what uninstalling leaves behind.

- [Diagrams in Confluence: four approaches compared](https://horizonventures.app/docs/diagrams-in-confluence-compared.html): draw.io, Mermaid, PlantUML or an attached SVG, chosen by the only question that matters: who edits the diagram next year.

- [Atlassian changes worth knowing](https://horizonventures.app/changes.html): a weekly note on Atlassian and Confluence Cloud changes that affect administrators, with what each change means in practice.
- [All articles](https://horizonventures.app/articles.html): index of every guide and write-up on this site.

- [Cloud Fortified is retiring: what app badges mean now](https://horizonventures.app/docs/cloud-fortified-retiring.html): Submissions closed on 1 September 2026, the programme ends on 31 December, and Atlassian Enterprise Certified takes over.

- [How to sum a column in a Confluence table](https://horizonventures.app/docs/sum-column-confluence-table.html): Tables have no formulas, databases total a field but never a row. The three real options, and when a spreadsheet is the honest answer.

- [How to split a Word document into multiple Confluence pages](https://horizonventures.app/docs/split-word-document-confluence-pages.html): Cloud makes one page per file. The free way around it runs through Word's outline view, with the hours it costs.

- [Confluence page list: show a list of pages without writing CQL](https://horizonventures.app/docs/list-confluence-pages-without-cql.html): Four native macros, twelve filters and no query language. Where each one stops, and what the content manager does instead.

- [What a Confluence space export actually gives you](https://horizonventures.app/docs/confluence-space-export-explained.html): Four formats, an admin-only button, and several things that vanish without a warning.

- [Can you import a Word document into an existing Confluence page?](https://horizonventures.app/docs/import-word-existing-confluence-page.html): Cloud always creates a new page. The four workarounds, and what paste from Word quietly breaks.

- [The Confluence content manager: what it does and where it stops](https://horizonventures.app/docs/confluence-content-manager.html): Premium only, archives 500 pages at once, and its stale-page filter silently skips every page that has children.

- [How to move a Google Doc into Confluence Cloud](https://horizonventures.app/docs/import-google-doc-into-confluence.html): The native import, where it fails, the .docx detour, and what to do with a document too long for one page.

- [Confluence databases or a table on a page](https://horizonventures.app/docs/confluence-database-or-table.html): What each one is for, where each stops, and how the data comes back out.

- [How to make a diagram clickable in Confluence Cloud](https://horizonventures.app/docs/clickable-diagram-confluence.html): Linking the boxes of a diagram: the steps in draw.io and Gliffy, and why an attached SVG loses its links.

- [How to export a Confluence database to Excel](https://horizonventures.app/docs/export-confluence-database-to-excel.html): The database exports to CSV, HTML or PDF, there is no Excel option, and the way back has a documented date trap.

- [How to find orphaned pages in Confluence Cloud](https://horizonventures.app/docs/find-orphaned-pages-confluence.html): The list is in space settings under Content, and it is called Hidden, not Orphaned. What it contains and where bulk clean-up stops.

- [How to get a list of Confluence pages with owners and dates](https://horizonventures.app/docs/list-confluence-pages-with-owner-and-dates.html): No single report exists: the content manager needs Premium, the CSV export works on any plan but its columns are undocumented.

- [Confluence page restrictions: why someone can't see a page](https://horizonventures.app/docs/why-cannot-see-confluence-page.html): Space permissions or page restrictions: which wins, why view restrictions cascade down, and where the list of restricted pages lives.

- [The Live Search macro: what it does, and where it breaks](https://horizonventures.app/docs/confluence-live-search-macro.html): Confluence Cloud has a Live Search macro, but it searches the space rather than the page and cannot match the middle of a word.

- [How to make an image clickable in Confluence Cloud](https://horizonventures.app/docs/confluence-clickable-image.html): A whole image can be a link in two clicks. Separate clickable areas cannot be done natively, because Cloud has no HTML macro.

- [Visio to Confluence Cloud: how to insert a Visio diagram](https://horizonventures.app/docs/insert-visio-diagram-confluence.html): Confluence Cloud will not preview a .vsdx attachment: it downloads instead. The four routes onto the page and what each costs later.

- [CQL Search alternative before Connect ends](https://horizonventures.app/docs/cql-search-alternative.html): CQL Search runs on Connect, which loses support on 31 January 2027: native and app replacements, and how to move saved queries.

- [Table Exporter alternative before Connect ends](https://horizonventures.app/docs/table-exporter-alternative.html): Table Exporter for Confluence runs on Connect, which loses support on 31 January 2027: free routes and Forge replacements for exporting tables to Excel.

- [Why a Confluence table breaks when pasted into Excel](https://horizonventures.app/docs/confluence-table-paste-excel-merged-cells.html): Random merged cells, lost leading zeros, long IDs in scientific notation and ranges turned into dates: tested causes and fixes.

- [Why Confluence's Word import drops text and images](https://horizonventures.app/docs/confluence-word-import-missing-content.html): Only the title came through, images became placeholders or arrived at full size: known causes, Atlassian's workarounds, what to fix in the .docx.

- [Text is not SVG - cannot display: why draw.io labels break](https://horizonventures.app/docs/drawio-svg-text-is-not-svg.html): draw.io stores labels as HTML inside the SVG; where it is not rendered you get cut-off text and dead links. The export settings that fix it.

- [Confluence CQL cheat sheet: queries you can copy](https://horizonventures.app/docs/confluence-cql-cheat-sheet.html): Tested CQL queries for stale pages, labels, starred pages, mentions and page trees, plus the traps that return wrong results.

- [How to find unpublished drafts in Confluence Cloud](https://horizonventures.app/docs/find-unpublished-drafts-confluence.html): Where Confluence Cloud shows a page you never published, and why search and CQL will not find it.

- [How to see your starred pages in Confluence Cloud](https://horizonventures.app/docs/confluence-starred-pages.html): Where Confluence Cloud lists your starred pages, the Ctrl+Alt+F shortcut and the CQL query for them.

- [Graphviz in Confluence Cloud: free and paid options](https://horizonventures.app/docs/graphviz-confluence-cloud.html): The apps that render Graphviz DOT in Confluence Cloud, what they cost, and how to keep node links clickable in an attached SVG.

- [Find every Confluence Cloud page that uses a macro](https://horizonventures.app/docs/find-pages-using-macro-confluence.html): How to find the pages that use an app's macro before you uninstall it, and the four cases where search returns zero.

- [How to export multiple Confluence pages to Word](https://horizonventures.app/docs/export-multiple-confluence-pages-to-word.html): Confluence exports one page at a time to Word; the free route through a multi-page PDF and the apps that export a page tree.

- [Broken image in Confluence Cloud: what the placeholder tells you](https://horizonventures.app/docs/broken-image-confluence.html): Three kinds of broken image placeholder in Confluence Cloud, the cause behind each, and how to restore a deleted image.

- [How to find all restricted pages in Confluence Cloud](https://horizonventures.app/docs/find-restricted-pages-confluence.html): The per-space restricted pages report, the inherited restrictions it misses, why CQL cannot help, and a script for the whole site.

Answers clients on the studio's own WhatsApp number, books sessions, sends Meta-approved reminders and passes requests to staff. Operated by HORIZON VENTURES E.I.R.L. (RUC 20612763888), Peru.
- [Yana privacy policy](https://horizonventures.app/yana/privacy.html): Yana is our WhatsApp assistant for wellness and fitness studios; it answers messages on the studio's own WhatsApp number and passes bookings to staff. Data is processed on the studio's behalf and stored in the EU.
